architecture: ANS global/local hierarchy with OV-SDF, STGHP, RPN-UQ and IGCR interfaces
primary_metric: delta(covered_2d_area_m2 * global_3d_f1_at_5cm) from a shared prefix
required_baselines: adapted official TARE after bridge closure
candidate_budget_rule: coverage_slots + optional rotation + entry and deep candidate for every measured asset; no asset may be omitted only because a fixed two-asset cap was retained
training_rule: training targets may be computed only after physically executing each development candidate; decision features may use observed audits only
confirmation_rule: freeze model, feature guard, candidate rule, budgets and gates before creating a disjoint future confirmation manifest
claim_boundary: Development preparation for large multi-asset artificial facilities; not confirmation, natural semantics, external-baseline performance or robot evidence
